excluded: any change to selector v1.2c or the frozen R1-R5 layer
contract.match_predicate: normalized canonical surface is an accepted surface of the entry AND candidate pos == 'noun_prop' AND normalized root == camel_selector.normalized_root AND normalized lemma == camel_selector.normalized_lemma
contract.no_guessing: if the predicate leaves more than one distinct lexical core the token is reported AMBIGUOUS_PROPER_NAME; if it leaves none it is reported UNRESOLVED_PROPER_NAME
contract.purpose: narrow, closed list of Quranic proper names used to resolve tokens the frozen selector v1.2c leaves unselected
runtime_inputs: the token's normalized canonical Tanzil surface
contract.teacher_use: development-time entry validation only - the selector never reads the teacher and this file contains no verse_key override
